text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon and Bitter Glasse pondered 
what they could do to awaken Acting 
Director Kashimoto.

The answer she reached was to defy 
micromanagement and, even through reckless 
training, produce results that exceeded 
all her calculations.

I thought that, in the long run, doing so 
would be for Acting Director Kashimoto's 
sake. And that it would also protect the 
place we'd finally found for 
ourselves—this team.

However, seeing her students begin to 
rebel against her, Acting Director 
Kashimoto regretted it, thinking, "Once 
again, my management has failed."
